88 ## Fallback / source-context notes

89 - The story artifact notes that no `sprint-status.yaml` was present under `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts` during story creation; verify the current location before relying on status metadata.

90 - Review input was derived only from the story artifact and its embedded completion notes, task list, file list, and review findings.

91+

92+## Latest Review Findings

93+

94+### F-01 — Restart hydration drops the child supervisor patch

95+- **source:** review-edge-case-hunter summary; story review findings F3

96+- **detail:** `hydrateRestartableCreateDialogues()` captures only the child output’s `flowId` and `phase`, then returns a root patch that records `hydratedCreateDialogueFlowIds` and `hydratedCreateDialoguePhasesByFlowId`. The `responsemachine` patch (`focusedFlowId` and `currentTurn.currentMachineStateValue`) is never merged into the root patch, so the root turn can remain stale after restart.

97+- **location:** `src/stately-studio/responsemachine.ts:256-266`; `src/stately-studio/chatsendrootmachinev2.ts:1076-1115`; `src/stately-studio/actors/workflow-reducer.ts:141-163`

98+- **bucket:** patch

99+

100+### F-02 — Hydration ignores the normalized `currentMachineStateValue` fallback

101+- **source:** review-edge-case-hunter summary

102+- **detail:** `normalizeWorkflowHydrationState()` preserves `record.currentMachineStateValue ?? record.snapshotRef?.phase`, but `buildCreateDialogueResumeInput()` still uses only `snapshotRef.phase`. Older or migrated records that only carry the phase in `currentMachineStateValue` rehydrate as `dialogue_collecting` instead of the persisted phase.

103+- **location:** `src/stately-studio/chatsendrootmachinev2.ts:519-530`; `src/stately-studio/actors/shared/workflow-registry.ts:994-1010`

104+- **bucket:** patch

105+

106+### F-03 — Phase-specific hydration can succeed with a blank `flowId`

107+- **source:** adversarial-review-findings.md

108+- **detail:** The `review_ready`, `save_pending`, and `gather_inputs` branches in `create-dialogue-machine.ts` check `context.phase` before the non-empty `flowId` guard. A persisted record with one of those phases and an empty or invalid `flowId` can still finalize as `supervised` and emit that bad identifier.

109+- **location:** `src/stately-studio/create-dialogue-machine.ts:75-97`; `src/stately-studio/create-dialogue-machine.ts:116-126`

110+- **bucket:** patch

111+

112+### F-04 — Renaming hydrated flow IDs leaves pending create proposals stale

113+- **source:** adversarial-review-findings.md

114+- **detail:** Restart normalization rewrites the record’s top-level `flowId`, but `pendingCreateDialogueProposals[].flowId` is not updated. Later adjudication looks up `context.activeFlows[input.event.payload.flowId]`, so retained proposals on a renamed record no longer match after restart.

115+- **location:** `src/stately-studio/chatsendrootmachinev2.ts:512-530`; `src/stately-studio/chatsendrootmachinev2.ts:843-849`; `src/stately-studio/actors/shared/workflow-registry.ts:188-199`

116+- **bucket:** patch

117+

118+## Tasks / Subtasks

119+

120+- [ ] Merge the child supervisor’s restart patch into the root hydration patch so `focusedFlowId` and `currentTurn.currentMachineStateValue` survive restart.

121+ - [ ] Forward or merge `snapshot.output.patch` from the create-dialogue supervisor into `hydrateRestartableCreateDialogues()` results.

122+ - [ ] Verify the root’s persisted workflow projection still reflects the hydrated machine state after reload.

123+

124+- [ ] Teach resume-input assembly to fall back to normalized `currentMachineStateValue` when `snapshotRef.phase` is absent.

125+ - [ ] Update `buildCreateDialogueResumeInput()` to use the normalized persisted phase source.

126+ - [ ] Add a regression test for migrated records that only contain `currentMachineStateValue`.

127+

128+- [ ] Harden create-dialogue hydration against blank or invalid `flowId` values.

129+ - [ ] Require a trimmed, non-empty `flowId` before phase-specific hydration can complete as supervised.

130+ - [ ] Ensure invalid identifiers fail hydration instead of emitting a malformed supervised result.

131+

132+- [ ] Rewrite nested proposal references when canonicalizing hydrated flow IDs.

133+ - [ ] Update `pendingCreateDialogueProposals[].flowId` when a record’s flow ID is normalized.

134+ - [ ] Check any other flow-ID-bearing nested payloads for the same restart-time rewrite requirement.

# Adversarial review findings

## 1) Phase-specific hydration can now succeed with a blank `flowId`

- **Locations**
  - `src/stately-studio/create-dialogue-machine.ts:75-97`
  - `src/stately-studio/create-dialogue-machine.ts:116-126`
- **Evidence**: The new `review_ready`, `save_pending`, and `gather_inputs` branches only check `context.phase`; they run before the existing non-empty `flowId` guard. If a persisted record has one of those phases but an empty/invalid `flowId`, the machine will still finalize as `supervised` and emit that bad `flowId` instead of failing hydration.

## 2) Renaming hydrated flow IDs leaves pending create proposals pointing at stale IDs

- **Locations**
  - `src/stately-studio/chatsendrootmachinev2.ts:512-530`
  - `src/stately-studio/chatsendrootmachinev2.ts:843-849`
  - `src/stately-studio/actors/shared/workflow-registry.ts:188-199`
- **Evidence**: Collision handling rewrites the record’s top-level `flowId`, but `WorkflowRecord` also carries `pendingCreateDialogueProposals`, and those proposal objects keep their original `flowId`. Later adjudication looks up the active record with `context.activeFlows[input.event.payload.flowId]`, so any retained proposal on a renamed record can no longer be matched after restart.
